title: Spectral Blade - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Spectral Blade trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Spectral Blade phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Missable. The quest is also the source of the Soft Snake Sword's thread-cutting utility, so finishing it early pays for itself.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Complete the side quest A Severed Mindseal.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 23 of 36 on the list - before it A Wanderer's Honor · after it The Healer's Legacy. It is missable, and the checklist of everything that expires is on the guide. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
